description: The celebratory dish of Dangi households: free-ranging country chicken cooked hard with red chilli, garlic and local masala, usually alongside nagli rotla or rice. It is rustic, fiery and lean — nothing like a city butter-chicken — and mostly lives in homes, small hotels in Ahwa and Waghai, and pre-arranged homestay dinners rather than tourist-facing menus. Vegetarian-dominant Saputara serves little of it; the interior does.
cultural_note: Chicken and goat mark festivals and guests in Dangi homes; being cooked a desi murgh is a gesture of regard.
